desc:
Hatch it. Feed it. Ride it. Fight it.
Your dragon lays eggs right in your yard — walk over them to collect, then hatch for one of 9 species, from a common Fire to the legendary Sovereign.
🧬 GENES — every hatch rolls HP / ATK / EGG genes from 0 to 6. Two of the same species are never the same dragon. Chase the perfect 18.
🍖 FEED — keep the trough full and watch it grow through 5 stages: Hatchling → Juvenile → Adult → Elder → Apex.
⚔️ ARENA — send your dragon out to auto-battle for coins. Two rings running at once, so there's no queue.
🪽 RIDE — grown winged dragons can be flown. Take off and loot the floating sky islands.
✨ SCALES — scales glitter across the world and fly off dragons mid-fight. Grab them, fill your satchel, run them home to the Smelter for instant coins.
🏠 UPGRADE — trough, egg field, stable, satchel, and a second dragon on your plot.
Walk up to your dragon and press F. It leans into your hand.
